questions.q: Look! The frog ___ in the pond.
questions.explain: 看到提示詞 Look! 表示動作正在進行，單數主語 The frog 配 is jumping。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Look! The frog ___ in the pond.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1B: Present Continuous, Can & Prepositions

questions.q: Birds ___ fly in the sky, but they can't swim underwater.
questions.explain: 表示能力「能夠／會飛」用情態動詞 can。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Birds ___ fly in the sky, but they can't swim underwater.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1B: Present Continuous, Can & Prepositions

questions.q: Where is the puppy? It is sleeping ___ the chair.
questions.explain: under the chair 表示「在椅子下面」。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Where is the puppy? It is sleeping ___ the chair.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1B: Present Continuous, Can & Prepositions

questions.q: What ___ the children doing? They are singing.
questions.explain: 複數主語 the children 在現在進行式疑問句中配助動詞 are。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: What ___ the children doing? They are singing.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1B: Present Continuous, Can & Prepositions

questions.q: ___ can you see in the park? I can see some flowers.
questions.explain: 詢問「看見甚麼東西」用疑問詞 What。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ can you see in the park? I can see some flowers.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1B: Present Continuous, Can & Prepositions

questions.q: Fill in the correct verb form: I am ___ (draw) a picture now.
questions.explain: am + 動詞 -ing 表示正在畫畫（drawing）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the correct verb form: I am ___ (draw) a picture now.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1B: Present Continuous, Can & Prepositions

questions.q: In 'A fish can flies', the verb form after 'can' is correct.
questions.explain: 情態動詞 can 後面必須用動詞原形（can fly），不可加 -s 或 -ies。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: In 'A fish can flies', the verb form after 'can' is correct.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 1B: Present Continuous, Can & Prepositions
